item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows three everyday uses of a convex mirror: a scooter side-view mirror, a mirror at a sharp road bend, and a shop surveillance mirror.

Why is a convex mirror chosen for these uses?

options.A: It forms erect, smaller images and gives a wider field of view than a plane mirror.
options.B: It forms a magnified image so distant objects look larger than life.
options.C: Any curved mirror works the same, so a concave mirror would serve equally well here.
options.D: It is chosen only because the glass looks shiny, not because of image size or field of view.
